summary: Keep Immich personal-library workflows statically discoverable and conservative: command wiring matches runtime help, every destructive selection requires reviewed evidence, and partial transfers cannot silently lose committed asset IDs, pending watch repairs, or collection members.
reason: The extension hook hid valid command edges from the shipped verifier, while review found safety gaps around inferred duplicate keepers, partial uploads and album assignment (including watch retries and duplicate asset UUID recovery), stale duplicate evidence, and malformed or partially mapped collection migration.
validated_outcome: verify_skill.py --strict resolves the novel command paths; focused regression tests cover evidence-locked suggested and explicit duplicate keepers, committed IDs retained across metadata and album-assignment failures, UUID-based duplicate retry and pending watch repair, and all source collections prevalidated before malformed or partially mapped data can mutate the destination.
